headline: Second EST-01 check: no ticket. ASCEND (46% above its line, Grumpy Walrus ~+6.6k ADA net over 72h, pool +4.2% 7d) and STRIKE (32% above, Wobbly Kiwi ~+53.7k ADA, pool -3.2% 7d) again fail only on the 7-day holder trend, which can't be measured until Nov 8; FLOW is 24.1% above its line, just under the 25% bar. Since 6:11 PM Grumpy Walrus kept its ~71 ADA repeat buys: ~229 ASCEND, ~77.5k MEPE, ~400 FLOW, net ADA ~-500. ANAKIN and MOGE passed their 24h gates unbonded. COCK ~147.4k, 1.8% under its line, Pass. Nothing passes k/y.
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus ASCEND net over 72h fell from ~+28.9k ADA (Nov 1) to ~+6.6k ADA as the big Oct 29-30 buys rolled out of the window and 3 sells of 1,000 plus one of 296 came in; its ASCEND buying is now only ~71 ADA fills, so condition 2 for ASCEND could fail by Nov 4 if the trims continue.

Changed: FLOW added to the EST-01 check (prefilter now lists it in est_universe) but sits at 24.1% above its line. dev_checks: 16 rows, 0 complete, 10 skipped (partial). Solana-side snipe candidate: none (closest CORE, 56 Solana-native holders).
